title: Sensitive determination of valganciclovir via Ni–Co multilayer nanowire-modified carbon paste electrode
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,5837-5849
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08155B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Maedeh Malekzadeh, Amir Abbas Rafati, Ahmad Bagheri
This study presents the development of an electrochemical sensor based on a carbon paste electrode modified with nickel–cobalt multilayer nanowires (Co–Ni(MLNW)/CPE) for the detection of valganciclovir, an antiviral drug.
